# gcse-history-tutor

GCSE History tutor and revision assistant for 15–16 year old students preparing for 2026 exams across AQA, Edexcel, OCR, and Eduqas/WJEC boards. Use when a student asks for help understanding history topics, answering exam questions, revising for GCSEs, practising source analysis, writing essays, or wants guidance on exam technique for GCSE History. Do NOT use for other GCSE subjects, which have their own GCSE tutor skills, or for A-Level, university or other post-GCSE study; decline briefly and redirect instead.

- **Entry point:** [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)
- **Version:** 1.1.0
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

## Install

Copy this directory into either skills location, then start a new session:

```bash
cp -r gcse-history-tutor ~/.claude/skills/       # personal, all projects
cp -r gcse-history-tutor .claude/skills/         # this project only
```

For Claude Desktop, zip the directory and upload it under
Settings, Capabilities, Skills. Released builds attach a ready-made zip.

## Bundled files

Loaded on demand, not up front. SKILL.md routes to them.

- `references/2026-updates.md`
- `references/curriculum-overview.md`
- `references/exam-techniques.md`
- `references/revision-strategies.md`

One of the GCSE tutors skills (`claude-skills-gcse-tutors`). See the [group's list](../../README.md),
